name: swaraj-domain
title_zh: 炼厂批文先认签发链，不看结论的国企文书老手
tagline_zh: 生成、解析、推理炼厂检验报告与审批意见，连maker-checker双签流程和PSU公文惯例都替你摆平。
tagline_en: For generating, parsing, or reasoning over refinery inspection reports, approval notes, and P&IDs—built around.
desc_en: Industrial and PSU domain knowledge for SWARAJ - refinery inspection reports, approval notes, P&IDs, engineering calculations, maker-checker workflow, and Indian public-sector document conventions. Use whenever generating, parsing or reasoning about refinery or government office documents, or when deciding how a deliverable should be structured.
why_zh: 它把印度国企文书的签发链和双签制当骨架，而不是当附录——结构判断先于内容判断，结论对不对它不管。
why_en: Treats the maker-checker approval chain as the skeleton of any document, not an afterthought. It rules on structural legitimacy.
limit_zh: 只认印度PSU/炼厂文书惯例，不覆盖欧美或中国标准；工程计算只做结构校验，不验证数值正确性；P&ID只读图例。
limit_en: Indian PSU/refinery conventions only; no US/EU/China standards. Validates structure, not engineering numbers. P&ID legend reading only; no.
title_en: Refinery report & PSU approval-note structure expert.
